title: mg.result
description: client → server → host (relayed inside `relay`). The compact result of one player's local minigame run. Exactly one per player and run, sent when play ends on the phone. The host accepts results until startAtMs + durationMs + 2000 ms on the server clock, then computes fraction, tier and boosts. Accepted while paused so that a result finished just before a pause is not lost.

success.description: True when the player met the minigame's success condition.

perfect.description: True when the player met the minigame's "perfect" condition (needed by everyone for Platinum). Implies `success`.

score.description: Performance quality 0–1. Solo rooms: this is the completion fraction (§10.3 Solo). Otherwise it only adds individual score points.

value.description: Raw measurement for minigames whose team median or average steers the flight (MG-09, MG-16, MG-20, MG-22, MG-24), in the unit defined by the minigame; null otherwise.

finishedAtMs.description: Sender's estimate of the server clock when play ended.

DataId.description: Identifier of an entry in the shared game data (`data/`): part, part category, contract, test, anomaly card, minigame, fact, codex entry, callout, console request, award, objective, validation rule, cosmetic. 1–48 characters.

MinigameMode.description: Input mode the player used (§16 Motor).

RunId.description: Minigame run identifier chosen by the host; unique within the room.

TimeMs.description: Absolute time on the server clock: integer milliseconds since the Unix epoch. Every `…AtMs` field in the protocol uses the server clock (see Clock).
